statement: CISA adds at least one new Microsoft-product vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry with vendorProject Microsoft and dateAdded between 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-30 inclusive; zero such entries grades MISS.
failure_condition: No Microsoft entry with dateAdded in the 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-30 range exists in the KEV catalog at the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-20 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The official ICE Brent front-month settlement price is at or above 100.00 USD on any trading day from 2026-08-20 through 2026-10-30; otherwise MISS.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement in the event window is below 100.00 USD.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
